description: What the page sends for a typed draft (`body`, or null when it refuses a blank one). The page trims Unicode White_Space as the service's str::trim does, and U+FEFF as well, so the body has nothing left for the service to trim: the service takes it unchanged. The service runs the cases whose draft has no U+FEFF through its own trim too, and must agree. A lone surrogate cannot be written here, as serde_json refuses a string holding one: the page's refusal of it is tested in transcriptComposer.test.tsx and the service's in test_protocol.rs.
